name: cainiao_full_suite_alpha05_v1
purpose: Publication experiment suite; do not change semantic fields after execution begins.

dataset.identifier: LaDe last-mile delivery dataset, delivery task table

preprocessing.arrival_process: Independent Poisson process of rate 1.0 per restaurant; exponential inter-arrivals seeded by (experiment_seed, restaurant_id).

dataset.required_preflight: All five source CSVs must exist before execution. Prepared-data summaries and source paths must be recorded in manifest.json.

replication.scenario_identity: One frozen order trace and shuffled full roster per (city, seed), replayed by every policy and fleet level.

fleet.selection: Prefix of the once-shuffled full roster.
fleet.size_rule: max(1, round(full_roster_size * fraction)) using Python round semantics

service_model.sensitivity_role: Completed pilot robustness check; do not multiply these values into the primary full suite.

warmup.definition: Exclude orders arriving before 5% of that scenario's arrival horizon.
warmup.resolved_duration: 0.05 * horizon, calculated separately for each (city, seed)

evaluation.arrival_horizon: Ceiling of the latest generated order-arrival time in the scenario.
evaluation.measurement_population: Orders with arrival_time >= warmup_duration; every generated arrival is <= arrival_horizon.
evaluation.completion_policy: Drain the event queue after the arrival horizon until empty.

flow_time.completion_time: The time that the individual order is delivered, not the completion time of the entire assigned batch.
flow_time.required_completion: Every measured arrival must be delivered; undelivered_orders must equal zero in every run.

utilization.primary_definition: For each driver, measure the union of non-idle intervals clipped to [warmup_duration, last_order_completion], divided by that window length; summarize across drivers.
utilization.diagnostic_definition: For each driver, measure the union of non-idle intervals clipped to [warmup_duration, arrival_horizon], divided by that window length; retain as a saturation diagnostic.

pairing.percentage_change: 100 * (policy_metric - erf_metric) / erf_metric; negative flow-time change is improvement.

aggregation.long_table: One row per (city, seed, supply_fraction, policy).
aggregation.t_interval: t_(0.975,n-1) * sample_sd / sqrt(n); for n=3, multiplier 4.303.
aggregation.paired_table: One policy-versus-ERF percentage change per matching seed and pairing cell.

required_top_level.manifest.json: Resolved command, code provenance, configurations, data summaries, and scenario manifests.
required_top_level.scenarios/<city>_seed<seed>.json: Frozen trace, roster, hashes, warm-up, and cost parameters.
required_top_level.aggregate/results_long.csv: One row per run, including metric and runtime fields.
required_top_level.aggregate/results_summary.csv: Across-seed means, standard deviations, and 95% t intervals.
required_top_level.validation_report.md: All checks must pass before results are used.

validation_requirements: Exactly one run for every declared experimental cell.
Identical trace, arrival count, and horizon across policies in a cell.
Identical driver roster across policies in a cell.
Cost parameters are identical across policies in a cell.
No policy leaves an order unfinished.

software.code_provenance_requirement: Execute only from a clean committed working tree; generated manifest.json must record that commit and working_tree_dirty=false.

execution.command: .venv/bin/python -m mvp_sim.experiments.run_suite --output results/canonical_alpha05_warmup05 --data-root . --cities cq hz jl sh yt --seeds 1 2 3 --driver-sweep --day 0610 --warmup-fraction 0.05 --cost-function sublinear_intrazone --batch-alpha 0.5 --speed 1.0 --baseline erf --jobs 8
preconditions: All five city CSVs exist at the declared paths.
uv sync --frozen and the full test suite pass.
The output directory does not already exist.
